semantics.kind: Combinational state-transition and Moore-output logic only; no registers, clock, reset port or added latency.
semantics.encoding_order: List index is state bit index, starting at bit 0.

outputs.shift_ena: B0 or B1 or B2 or B3 active

semantics.reset_initial_evidence: Original states reset starts in S but explicitly requests only combinational portion and provides state input without clock/reset. External owner supplies S at reset; DUT has no initialization or reset logic.

numeric.arithmetic: Boolean bit equations; no arithmetic or signed values

verification.oracle: Independent case-based implementation of original full transition table followed by requested next-state decoding and Moore output expectations.
verification.coverage: All 10 legal one-hot states times all 8 binary input combinations; directed full-state traversal, loops, S reset-state input and immediate changes.
verification.sampling: Drive combinational inputs then wait 1 ns for settling; no clock-edge semantics.
verification.failure: Case-inequality mismatch uses $fatal; bounded timeout; PASS emitted after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Illegal zero-hot/multi-hot states and unknown inputs are unspecified. Implement direct one-hot Boolean equations without invalid-state recovery; primary oracle checks only legal one-hot states with binary inputs.
